Vitae AI is a self-hosted AI assistant I built to answer questions about my career, projects, and interests, running Qwen3.5 on llama.cpp v0.8.0 on an Oracle Cloud Ampere A1 virtual machine. In my handwritten digit classifier project, I chose the value of K by performing a validation sweep across odd K values from 1 to 19 and selecting the one with the highest validation accuracy. For the 5 versus 6 run, I selected K = 3 because it achieved the highest validation accuracy (~99.3%), even though K = 1 had slightly higher training accuracy. I separated the training, validation, and test sets to ensure the best K was determined by validation performance before reporting the final test accuracy.
